tools.name: get_transfer_price
tools.description: Fixed price in EUR for a private AHM Transfer ride between two places in the Alanya / Antalya region of Turkey. The price is per vehicle (not per person) and the same in both directions. Returns "no list price" for pairs that are quoted on request. Known places: Gazipaşa Airport (GZP); Antalya Airpo

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: All AHM Transfer routes that have a fixed list price, with distance and duration. Prices are in EUR per vehicle.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Facts about AHM Transfer: vehicles, passenger capacity, payment, cancellation, flight-delay and child-seat policy, service area, languages, contact details and the FAQ.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Builds a link to AHM Transfer's booking page with the request (route, date, time, passengers) already filled in.
